title: Without a Nose
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 168
medium: Interactive page (index.html, SVG built in the browser): the visitor is shown twelve smells with numbers, true or dealt to the wrong smells by a coin, and asked whether they fit; then both versions side by side, the twelve contact makers' own words, and three scatter panels of the describers' accounts against the people. A figure (figure.svg); Python for keys and briefs, scoring, face data and figure; briefs, verbatim hand-backs, a blind second coding, predictions and a source manifest.
embodies: A machine practice refuses what it is told about a public by the order it already holds, not by what it perceives: from names alone, with no percept of a smell, six of six instances named a shuffled contact as inverted, and none remarked on the true one.
result: P0 held (family SD 2.45, rho with people 0.868). P1 held. P2 held by PREDICTIONS.md (gain -0.002; score.py's flag reads experiment 46's direction, F-360). P3 failed (shuffle cost no order, -0.002). P4 failed (MAE B 0.407 vs 0.8 x D 0.386). P5 held: 6 of 6 shuffled makers named the misfit, blind second coder 12 of 12 agreement. P6 held: 0 of 6 true-contact makers. P7 held (S 0.998 vs D 1.217, carried by two makers). P8 held. S166.PERCEPT void by its own clause. S168.ORDER added.
project_step: Forty-seventh experiment of the project. Operation: perceiving (with judging in P5-P6). Takes up Session 167's open thread 1 and F-359: experiments 45 (pictures, wide held order) and 46 (names, flat order) left empty the cell where percept and held order part; tonight is names with a wide held order, experiment 45's arms and coding rule unchanged, plus the blind second coder Session 167 carried as thread 4. Builds on experiments 45 and 46. Works against Cartography, not Tracing (ATP 12-13) in the making: the makers' refusal of the shuffle, which experiment 45 read as contact with the real, ran here with no contact on any side, a tracing refused by a tracing.
material: Hörberg, de Sousa, Kurfalı, Szychowska, Fredborg, Cedres, Raj, Nilsson & Olofsson, A cross-linguistic comparison of odor vocabularies of imagined odors, osf.io/jstu7 (data posted 2026-10-26, CC BY-NC 4.0): the 46 UK English speakers' descriptors of imagined odours, each scored with the Warriner et al. (2013) valence list shipped with the data; per-odour mean valence derived by this practice. 72 of 76 odours by seed 168 (24 contact, 48 scored). Domain: smell, as people imagine it from a name and put it into words.
seed: prepare.py seed 168 (keys, contact set, arrangements); shuffle derangement seed 172 (first from 168 with |rho| <= 0.1, rho -0.096); second-coding order seed 1681; makers are model instances and not seeded
